description: issue #682 (slice I3): the STATIC checker agrees with the runtime that a `when` handler body is a fresh control-flow boundary, not a procedure body. Even though this `when` is written inside `define setup`, the handler block is not part of `setup`'s procedure body, so `return` inside it is `return` outside any procedure — the semantic control-flow rule (issue #114, spec/error-model.md `ol-return-outside-proc`) reports it pointing at the `return` control word. This is the check-side companion to the runtime fixture `when-return-in-handler-inside-proc`: without it, static tooling would accept code the runtime rejects. `interaction-events` is not in `SUPPORTED_PROFILES` (terminal slice #688 claims it), but a fixture may request it for `check()`.

diagnostics.message: return only reports a value from inside a procedure. put it between 'define' and 'end'.
